name: The Brood of Onyxia
label: Quest
description: Overlord Mok'Morokk has no wish to hear about dragons. He says there are no black dragons here and sends you back to Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village…
intro: Overlord Mok'Morokk has no wish to hear about dragons. He says there are no black dragons here and sends you back to Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village with the news that the ogres are staying.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You leave me alone now. Go tell Draz'Zilb we stay here. No black dragon here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mok'Morokk displayed strength when Rexxar was our leader. But soon after Rexxar's departure Mok'Morokk fell prey to temptations of power. Rather than lead, he demanded. He does not serve his people but rather expects us to serve him.
